locations.name: Basalt Gate
locations.description: A black basalt watch-gate spans a narrow valley above a white-water river, joining two squat towers with a single stone arch.
architecture: Two squat square basalt towers joined by one stone arch
An eastern buttress rests on the valley slope
A narrow bridge approach rises from the viewer side
landmarks: A single bronze bell in the left tower
A split mountain crest in the distance
